candidates.title: At UN, Pezeshkian turns terrorism accusation back on Iran’s critics
candidates.summary: President Masoud Pezeshkian opened his General Assembly address with a direct rebuttal to US President Donald Trump, who a day earlier had branded Iran the “number one sponsor of terror.”

candidates.title: Trump defends military action against Iran, Venezuela, and calls for rebrand of AI
candidates.summary: US President Donald Trump used his address to the UN General Assembly on Tuesday to defend recent military action against Iran, urging countries to maintain economic pressure on Tehran – and declaring that he now faces a choice between making a deal, or taking far more drastic steps.
